model_card.summary: Separate Fashion-MNIST label and FSDD spoken-digit pipeline checkpoints with per-file MIT/CC-BY-SA licenses.
model_card.scope: Inspect very small real-data training and custom held-out image/speaker evaluation.
limitations: Small generated tasks and fixed splits do not establish natural-image perception, speech recognition, general instruction following or broad multimodal reasoning.
Greedy generation and intervention scores are measured separately; successful loading on generated input is not accuracy evidence.
Fashion uses 50 upstream-training images and custom 3/1/1 per label; FSDD uses 20 recordings per speaker split from original-training indices. These are not official benchmark evaluations.
The language starts from synthetic sft/model.pt; pretrained=False leaves encoders fresh rather than resetting the language model.
Fashion test exact match is 3/10; FSDD test exact match is 3/20 despite EOS on every output. These small pilots do not establish general garment or speech recognition.

FSDD language context is expanded from 128 to 176 using the maximum waveform length across all three splits plus a margin; the first 128 absolute position rows are copied and the new rows initialized. This is an input-length configuration rule, not held-out label training.

Original FSDD 8 kHz mono PCM-16 inputs are actually resampled into 16 kHz FLOAT WAVs; no explicit extra waveform gain, peak or RMS normalization is applied. Resampling adds no new above-Nyquist information.
Default CLI media are generated shapes/tones for loading only; real pilot predictions require appropriate user-supplied images or speech.

inference.method: Unpack the repository's separately licensed fixed source archives using the existing asset CLI, then run a real image/recording example. Run from the project root with installed Python.
inference.scope: The two inputs are individual held-out source examples for operation, not a new accuracy evaluation. Original media remain in the separate source archives; none are included in the weight package. Default scene/tone inputs in the automated manifest command are load/generation smoke checks, not garment or spoken-digit inputs.

fashion-mnist.pt.scope: Single real source example for operation only; not quality evidence.

fsdd.pt.scope: Single real source example for operation only; not quality evidence. --resample-audio performs actual 8→16 kHz conversion for original FSDD WAVs.

review.scope: Reviewed both final native multimodal file hashes, fresh encoder/projector plus synthetic SFT language initialization, all card/report metrics, mixed per-file MIT/CC-BY-SA notices and source revisions. Fashion custom30/10/10 gives test3/10; speaker-held-out FSDD20/20/20 gives test3/20 and validation5/20. Verified all60 real resampling records8k→16k with doubled points, max context176 and 3072 extra parameters; no new high-frequency information or benchmark claim. Actual source-image/WAV/resample CLI recipes checked. Public export still requires native reconstruction, anonymous pinned-file roundtrip and student CPU probes on these real examples.
